label: deterministic admission model, not engine measurement
assumptions: two slots at 50ms each vs six contending slots at 150ms each; synthetic service times

label: native hot-row workload
statement: BEGIN; UPDATE capacity_hot SET v=v+1 WHERE id=1; SELECT pg_sleep(0.01); COMMIT
scope: deliberately holds one row lock for at least 10ms; warm local server; five requests per client, not a database benchmark
